qa.question: How do I process a customer refund?
fails: answer has none of ['check stock', 'Check stock']
qa.text: Open Orders, find the order, and only refund it if its status is Delivered and the item is back in stock [S1][S6]. Choose a refund reason, click Issue refund, type the order number again, then click Confirm refund and wait for the green confirmation message [S1][S3][S4][S2]. The Customer refund process (simulated back office) says refunds above $200 need a supervisor code [S1]. The How to process a customer refund (screen recording, simulated back office) says refunds above $500 need a supervisor code [S5].

qa.question: Why do we check stock before paying a refund?
qa.text: We check stock because the returned item must be back in stock before any refund is paid [S1]. The item has to be back on the shelf before we pay anything out [S2].

qa.question: Above what amount does a refund need a supervisor code?
qa.text: The Customer refund process states refunds above $200 need a supervisor code [S1]. The How to process a customer refund screen recording states any refund above $500 needs a supervisor code [S2].

qa.question: What was Viet Nam's GDP growth in 2023?
qa.text: The ASEAN Economic Indicators Report reports Viet Nam's 2023 real GDP growth as 5.0 percent [S1] [S2], while the Regional expansion review deck reports Viet Nam grew 6.5% in 2023 [S4]. The ASEAN Economic Indicators Report states the Philippines grew fastest in 2023 at 5.5 percent [S2], while the Regional expansion review deck states Viet Nam was the fastest economy in ASEAN at 6.5% [S4].

qa.question: Which country grew fastest in 2024?
qa.text: Viet Nam grew fastest in 2024 with real GDP growth of 7.0 percent [S1]. It was ahead of Cambodia at 6.0 percent and the Philippines at 5.7 percent [S1]. Figure 1 also ranks Viet Nam first at 7.0 percent [S4].

qa.question: How did Myanmar's economy do in 2024?
qa.text: Myanmar's real GDP contracted by 1.0 percent in 2024 [S1]. Its GDP was 74.1 in current US$ billions [S4]. Manufacturing value added was 25.1 percent of GDP [S4].

qa.question: How much can I spend per month without asking?
qa.text: You can spend up to $5,000 per month from your User Limit in Brex [S3]. For books, spending up to $50/month is fine and requires no extra permission [S1].

qa.question: How many days off am I expected to take each year?
qa.text: PostHog offers unlimited time off, but expects you to take at least 25 days off a year, including national holidays [S1]. The 25 days is a minimum, not a guide [S1].

qa.question: How long is the notice period if I resign?
qa.text: We ask for 30 days of notice by default, and for team members to work during that notice period [S2]. A different maximum or minimum limit may apply locally [S2].

qa.question: How much can I spend on books each month without asking?
qa.text: You can spend up to $50/month on books without asking for permission [S1].

qa.question: Who owns a side project that I built using company code?
qa.text: Projects built using PostHog code belong to PostHog and should live in PostHog repos [S2]. You will need explicit permission to develop these projects further on the side [S2].

qa.question: How much time do company meetings take per week at most?
qa.text: Company meetings take no more than 2hrs total per week. [S1]
